faq_heading: New construction in Central Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Central Abbotsford sold for?
faq.a: 298 condos sold in Central Abbotsford at a median of $390,000, with the middle half between $325,000 and $453,750.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: In Central Abbotsford, houses were quickest at 22 days at a median, and condos slowest at 36 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Central Abbotsford are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Central Abbotsford, condos had the newest median build year, 1996.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Central Abbotsford: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less, so this year's completions and homes still being built. items.t: In Central Abbotsford, houses sold at a median of $980,000 across 77 sales, and the middle half closed between $895,000 and $1,115,000. The median house sat 22 days and sold for 96.7% of list.
Central Abbotsford: 105 townhomes sold at a median of $620,000, with the middle half between $540,000 and $692,000. The median townhome took 26 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

298 condos sold in Central Abbotsford at a median of $390,000 (middle half $325,000 to $453,750). A typical condo in Central Abbotsford spent 36 days on the market and closed at 97.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 4 Duplexes also sold in Central Abbotsford, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Central Abbotsford compares with the rest of Abbotsford

items.t: Houses in Central Abbotsford have the second lowest median of 7 Abbotsford sub-areas, $980,000. Poplar is lowest at $925,000 and Bradner highest at $1,575,000. Poplar ($925,000) sits just below and Matsqui ($997,000) sits just above.

Of 5 Abbotsford sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Central Abbotsford ranks second lowest at $620,000; the range is $580,000 (Poplar) to $720,000 (Abbotsford East). Poplar ($580,000) sits just below and Abbotsford West ($635,000) sits just above.

Condos in Central Abbotsford have the second highest median of 4 Abbotsford sub-areas, $390,000. Abbotsford West is lowest at $349,900 and Abbotsford East highest at $456,000. Poplar ($384,000) sits just below and Abbotsford East ($456,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Central Abbotsford (median 1996) and houses the oldest (median 1980), a gap of 16 years.
